name: Wooden jetty
description: A short wooden jetty section about 4 m long and 1.6 m wide: weathered planks with uneven gaps laid across two stringers on crossbeams, held up by four pairs of round timber posts standing on the ground, with a taller mooring post wrapped in rope at one end.
